title: James Williams – Curating The Getty's Assets (Capital Allocators, EP.50)

reader_summary.headline: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators.
reader_summary.overview: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators. This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. Through conversations with leaders in the money game, we learn how these holders of the keys to the kingdom allocate their time and their capital.

thesis: The speaker describes his background as a small-town Michigan native who worked on auto assembly lines before earning an engineering degree and later transitioning into finance and investing. He explains that upon joining the Getty Trust in 2002, his charge was to shift the portfolio from being largely invested in public market stocks and bonds to a more diversified structure that included hedge funds and private equity.
